sloka: कुम्भकर्णः प्रमत्तस्तु महर्षीन्धर्मवत्सलान् ।त्रैलोक्यं भक्षयन्नित्यासन्तुष्टो विचचार ह ।। ७.९.३८ ॥
transliteration: kumbhakarṇaḥ pramattastu maharṣīndharmavatsalān ।trailokyaṁ bhakṣayannityāsantuṣṭo vicacāra ha ।। 7.9.38 ॥

translations.english: Kumbhakarna, reckless and ever unsatisfied, roamed about, devouring great sages devoted to dharma and causing havoc in the three worlds.
